operator_notes: WordPress PDF Embedder — bulletins are <a class="pdfemb-viewer" href="...pdf"> in page HTML (not a separate iframe URL).
Filenames use ordinals: 21st-June-2026.pdf — harvester reads live hrefs, never rewrites captured URLs.
do_not: Do not use wp-block-file or *bulletin*.pdf pattern — Antrim uses PDF Embedder links only.
Do not pin a dated PDF filename in the recipe.
